summary: Independently reproduced and verified all 4 startup guard scenarios from the production RCA. Created /app/backend/tests/test_startup_guards.py (5 tests, all pass). Also re-ran watchdog+sweep and trust_enrichment regression suites (12 passed, 1 skipped due to no LLM key). The critical STARTUP GUARD 1 (IndexOptionsConflict on invites.expires_at TTL) is confirmed fixed: backend logs 'Lifespan startup begin' -> WARNING 'Index create skipped on invites(expires_at): ...IndexOptionsConflict...' -> 'Lifespan startup complete', supervisor stays RUNNING (not restart-looping), and admin login returns 200 in <1s.

minor.issue: Both fail at import time if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env is not exported to the shell where pytest runs (they read os.environ directly at module scope). Workaround: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...` before pytest, or move URL load into a fixture. Not a code regression from this iteration.

rca of the issue: Confirms Support's RCA: an IndexOptionsConflict on invites.expires_at TTL (expireAfterSeconds mismatch across deploys) raised inside @app.on_event('startup') caused uvicorn to shut down with exit 0. Fix wraps each create_index call, sweep, admin seed (with nested verify_password guard), init_storage, and scheduler kickoff in independent try/except blocks, logging warnings and letting startup complete. Reproduced locally by deliberately creating a TTL index with expireAfterSeconds=999 — backend booted cleanly with the expected warning, and admin login succeeded in <1s. Fix verified working.
